payload.rationale_summary: The rating reflects Sunrise Pharma's established track record in API manufacturing, healthy operating margins (20.7% EBITDA), and low leverage (D/E 0.75x). The stable outlook factors in consistent revenue growth and diversified product portfolio. Rating constrained by group complexity (4 entities) and FDA warning on group entity.
key_rating_drivers: Established API manufacturer with WHO-GMP certified facilities
Healthy EBITDA margin at 20.7% above pharma median
Low leverage: D/E at 0.75x, comfortable debt service
Group complexity: 4 entities, FDA warning on Sunrise Biotech
Unlisted — limited access to equity capital markets

rating_sensitivity.upgrade: Resolution of group entity FDA issue, revenue >₹500 Cr, listing
rating_sensitivity.downgrade: FDA action on main entity, D/E >1.5x, or group entity SMA-2/NPA
